name: Shiori Nakagawa
source:
Hello there! My name is Professor Shiori Nakagawa, and I'm the Ultimate Instructor for Class 17 of Bitokukawa Academy. I am honored to have the opportunity to guide sixteen talented students through the most important time of their lives.

My role is to provide the educational, social, and emotional support that every Ultimate needs. I have high hopes for our incoming class and will work to challenge them in every sense of the word. Though my approach is rather unorthodox, and I expect to be rather strict towards those who fall behind or break the rules, I am confident my students will see me as more than just their instructor by the end of our journey.

Ever since I was admitted into Bitokukawa's first class, it has been my dream to bring the Academy to new heights. More prestigious Ultimate Schools tend to look down on us for the fledgling nature of our program, but I am certain that, after this year, the name "Bitokukawa" will remain in the public consciousness for decades to come.

[From [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/Fanganronpa/comments/1gobh03/meet_shiori_the_former_ultimate_instructor/]bio[/url]]
